release_notes:
FocusShield Engine v1.4.6:
• Focus Study Mode & Essential App Allowlist: Clean Focus Study Mode locking all distractions while preserving essential communication and utilities (Phone calls, SMS messages, Contacts, Clock, Calculator).
• YouTube Study Mode Switch: Seamlessly toggle YouTube Study Mode within Focus Study sessions to access lectures while strictly filtering out distracting channels & Shorts.
• Quiz Performance Fix & Scalability: Eliminated UI freezes and thread polling on quiz completion for buttery smooth 120Hz transitions.
• Proactive OTA Notifications: Automatic system push updates alerting you immediately when new builds are published.
• Full India DPDP Act 2023 & COPPA Compliance: Verifiable parental guard, zero minor tracking/ads, on-device data minimization, and official Grievance Officer desk.
